newsitem.title: CHINA: Wing Lung FRCD raised to HK$650 mln.
newsitem.headline: Wing Lung FRCD raised to HK$650 mln.

text.p: Wing Lung Bank's floating-rate certificates of deposit issue has been increased to HK$650 million from HK$500 million, arranger Jardine Fleming Bank said.
The five-year certificates have put and call options on the third and fourth anniversary, and were issued at par to float at 35 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for participants is 50 basis points.
Jardine Fleming Bank and Schroders Asia are the arrangers.
Other participants are Development Bank of Singapore, Dresdner Bank, Westdeutsche Landesbank and Westpac Banking Corp.
The issue is made from a HK$3.0 billion certificate of deposit programme.
